lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Vertical columns of high-intensity circular clusters arranged in a grid-like pattern posterior to the gills, with approximately 5-6 distinct nodes visible per vertical column across the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows, creating a coordinate-like matrix where high-luminance blobs act as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature displays a sharp luminance shift, with a light-reflecting upper edge and a shadowed lower edge running parallel to the dorsal midline across the mid-flank.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 7-9 distinct high-luminance blobs located within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin, primarily concentrated near the base and trailing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density, radial pattern of smaller luminance points transitioning into larger, more distinct spots toward the distal margin.
